author: MetaBallStudios
description:
In fiction, whether in movies, books, or video games, many buildings and structures of all sizes appear, some of them truly enormous. In this video, we compare some of them in the most coherent way possible, placing them against the backdrop of New York City to give a complete perspective of their scale.

WARNING: Many examples were not selected due to imprecise information (or the impossibility of estimating it), or because they lack a clear structure for accurate representation (examples from novels). Some cases deviate from the general concept being sought; for example, primarily spatial structures, as well as cities, are excluded.
There may be inaccuracies or inconsistencies in some measurements as they are simple estimates; we will try to take the most reasonable measurement.

~ - Approximate
± - Error range
*UM - Unreliable Measure
White texts have sources
Yellow texts are MBS estimates
